 singapore OCBC mobile, internet banking services being restored progressively: Spokesperson
 OCBC's mobile banking and online services were inaccessible to users. PHOTO: AsiaOne PUBLISHED ON October 23, 2026 7:27 AM BY Swetha Sundararajan OCBC customers could not access mobile and internet banking services this afternoon.
 They were also unable to use the Paynow services during lunch hour.
 OCBC said on its Facebook page that it is working to resolve the issue and the services are being "restored progressively".
 As at 1pm, more than 700 reports were sighted on Downdetector.
 In a media reply, an OCBC spokesperson said: "Some customers faced intermittent slowness accessing our mobile and internet banking services earlier this afternoon."
 Services have since been progressively restored, while ATM and card services have not been affected. 
 OCBC assures users that their funds are safe and that no customer data has been compromised.
 "We apologise for the inconvenience and would like to thank our customers for their patience and understanding."
